label: env_identity
command: set -o pipefail; pwd; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; git log -3 --oneline --decorate; uname -a; python3 --version; pytest --version

label: repo_inventory
command:
set -o pipefail; printf "== top ==
"; ls -la; printf "== tests ==
"; find tests -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort; printf "== python test files ==
"; find . -type f -name "test_*.py" -not -path "*/.git/*" | sort; printf "== scripts/modules likely ==
"; find system scripts evidence -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n "1,500p"

label: prior_contract_extract
command:
set -o pipefail; R=evidence/00-baseline/codex-external/验收报告-第七轮.md; P=evidence/00-baseline/codex-external/方案.md; printf "== report headings ==
"; rg -n "^#|P0|P1|W[0-9]|三移除|P1f|schema|SC-05|UI-01|BAK-01|§20|§25\.1|TLA|acceptance|selftest|pytest" "$R" | sed -n "1,500p"; printf "== plan section 20..25 ==
"; awk '/^## 20/{f=1} /^## 26/{f=0} f{print NR ":" $0}' "$P" | sed -n "1,600p"; printf "== plan P1f anchors ==
"; rg -n "P1f|断言|SC-05|UI-01|BAK-01|三移除|移除|级联|schema" "$P" | sed -n "1,500p"

label: acceptance_source
command:
set -o pipefail; sed -n "1,300p" tests/acceptance.sh; printf "
== remainder ==
"; sed -n "301,800p" tests/acceptance.sh; printf "
== P1f scripts ==
"; rg -n "P1f|assert-baseline|effective|assertion|ac_traceability|selftest|pytest" tests system tools .github | sed -n "1,600p"

label: acceptance_p1_sections
command:
set -o pipefail; nl -ba tests/acceptance.sh | sed -n "500,1100p"; printf "== trace tool ==
"; nl -ba tools/ac_traceability.py | sed -n "1,420p"; printf "== baseline ==
"; cat tests/p1f-assert-baseline.txt; printf "== trace help ==
"; python3 tools/ac_traceability.py --help

label: acceptance_tail
command: set -o pipefail; wc -l tests/acceptance.sh; nl -ba tests/acceptance.sh | sed -n "260,520p"; printf "== P1f implementation ==\n"; rg -n -C 12 "P1f|assert-baseline|effective_assert|1205|AST|assert True|pytest.skip" tests/acceptance.sh tools/ac_traceability.py system/tests | sed -n "1,1000p"

label: claimed_commands
command: set -o pipefail; rg -n "21.*套|21.*test|6.*selftest|模块自测|自测 rc|ALL GREEN|67/67|pytest" CHANGELOG.md README.md evidence docs .github system/tests | sed -n "1,1000p"
